answer: Each dawn, one identity holds the lantern watch over the horizon: a randomly drawn, non-transferable window in which only that watcher can earn by reporting the first sparrow call, backed by a continuous ambient recording from before the event. Windows rotate unpredictably and only one pays per dawn. A sybil fleet gains nothing from extra clones — they hold no paying window — and faking a second watch means maintaining a separate all-night recording every night, so numbers stop multiplying rewards.
